title: FOLLOW THE PIPER
key: A minor (harmonic minor, tritone D# colour)

loop.note: Exactly 37 bars. The ending's reverb tail is folded onto the start, and the last bar's G#4 pickup resolves into the opening A4, so the file loops sample-accurately.

narration_window.note: Bars 1-2: solo flute over a low drone, bell tail and soft heartbeat drum. The flute is silent at 1.78-2.42 s and 3.10-3.53 s (the hook's written pause); the bed underneath sits about 18 dB below the flute.

sections.name: intro_hook
sections.description: The Piper's call, alone over a breathing A drone and a heartbeat frame drum. Narration space in the bar-2 pause.

sections.name: rats_awaken
sections.description: Stomps, claps, plucked strumstick, shaker; bass arrives, then kick and darbuka. The hook completes its first full statement.

sections.name: first_drop
sections.description: The whole town dances: kick, galloping 'rat-run' bass, claps + rope snare, stomps, tambourine, darbuka, psaltery chops, buzzing hurdy-gurdy, soprano octave.

sections.name: betrayal
sections.description: The expected cadence turns: Bb (bII) then Eb (tritone) under an A drone that refuses to move. Half-time, a stop with only stomps, laughter in the dark; groove re-ignites on E.

sections.name: piper_returns
sections.description: The hook returns darker and stranger: breathy flute with a detuned ghost unison, minor-9th rub (A against Bb), humming crowd doubling the tune, wrong-note giggle answered by laughter.

sections.name: final_drop
sections.description: Strongest section: hook + soprano octave + hurdy-gurdy counter-line, chanting crowd, choir, panting breaths, anvil sparks; second pass loses its pauses (obsession), then a stuttering extra bar.

sections.name: disappearance
sections.description: Layers vanish bar by bar while the pulse keeps walking; the flute is left alone, its last giggle and G#4 pickup lead straight back into the opening A4 (loop).

accents.description: Tritone D#5 hang -- the Piper's signature note
First wordless crowd answer 'hu-HA' in the hook's pause
Snare roll + crowd inhale into the drop
Band stop: the pause in the hook, crowd chant answers
Ornamented hook + tresillo stomps + solo claps
Band stop: the pause in the hook, crowd chant answers
Harmony betrays: Bb under the hook, gong
Half-time on the tritone Eb, low tenor recorder
Unison hit, then the rhythmic pause (only stomps)
Groove re-ignites on E; chromatic creep E-F-F#-G-G#
Children's breathy laughter answers the giggle
Giggle lands on Bb5 instead of B5, bends down
Second pass: stomps/claps double, panting breaths, high eerie choir
No pause anymore: the call repeats where the giggle was
Obsessive stutter bar: 16th bass, 'HA' on every beat
Choir, gurdy, strings and octave flute gone
Bass gone; kick filtered; distant laugh
Kick gone; only stomps, claps, humming
G#4 pickup resolves into the A4 at 0.000 s (seamless loop)
